svg.title: Pure destructive interference
svg.desc: Two identical waves, each of amplitude X, arrive exactly out of phase: the crests of one line up with the troughs of the other. They cancel completely, and the resultant has zero amplitude. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: The two sinusoidal waves share a frequency and wavelength. Varying the phase parameter gives a sum
